shots.intent: Dissatisfaction: a finished piece that is almost right, and someone who can see it isn't.
shots.super: The best designers are never satisfied.

frame.prompt: Overhead macro of a sheet of uncoated off-white paper on an ink-blue drafting surface at night. A crisp cobalt rectangle is printed on the paper. A steel scalpel blade rests against the rectangle's right edge, about to take away a sliver no thicker than a hair
directions: photographic, almost clinical, hard edge of light across the paper
warmer and quieter, the light pooled only on the blade and the edge

motion.prompt: The blade draws down the edge in one steady stroke and lifts away, leaving a hairline sliver of cobalt curling free
motion.camera: locked overhead, very slow push in

shots.intent: Purpose: start with why. A needle settling on a true direction.

frame.prompt: A brass compass with no markings on its face lies on deep ink-blue felt; its fine needle is still swinging, slightly off true
directions: seen from a low three-quarter angle, the needle catching the only light
straight down, the compass small in a large dark field

motion.prompt: The needle swings, slows and settles exactly, with one last tiny correction

shots.intent: Identity: personality is the product. A mark that means something, made once and made well.
shots.super: Give it a personality worth keeping.

frame.prompt: A brass seal with an abstract geometric device, raked stripe and circle, hovers just above a pool of deep cobalt sealing wax on paper
directions: the seal in sharp focus, wax soft below
the wax in focus, the seal a dark shape entering the frame

motion.prompt: The seal presses down into the wax, holds, and lifts cleanly, leaving a crisp raised stripe and circle
motion.camera: slow dolly in at table height

shots.intent: Craft: the small fixes. A plane taking one translucent curl from an edge until it is true.

frame.prompt: Extreme close-up of a block plane resting on the edge of a pale planed board, a single translucent wood shaving beginning to curl from its mouth, ink-blue darkness beyond
directions: low angle along the edge, the board's line leading into the dark

motion.prompt: The plane glides along the edge and a long, unbroken, paper-thin shaving curls up and away
motion.camera: tracking alongside the plane at its speed

shots.intent: Presentation: work is judged as it is shown. A finished object revealed under one good light.
shots.super: Show it as well as you made it.

frame.prompt: A small cobalt enamel object of simple, beautiful form stands on a slowly turning ink-blue plinth, a single soft key light from high left
directions: the object half in shadow, only its edge lit
the object fully lit against a gradient of ink to deep blue

motion.prompt: The plinth turns a quarter turn and the light travels across the enamel surface
motion.camera: slow arc left around the object

shots.intent: Selection: many options, biased towards distinction. One object stands apart from the familiar ones.
shots.super: Choose the one only you could make.

frame.prompt: Five small objects of similar shape stand in a row on paper: four in matte grey, one in deep cobalt enamel with a single precise yellow line, ink-blue shadow around them
directions: low angle along the row, the cobalt object nearest
high angle, the cobalt object in the middle of the row

motion.prompt: The light narrows until only the cobalt object is lit and the grey objects fall into shadow

shots.intent: Close: back to the sheet. Now it is right, and it still isn't finished.

frame.prompt: The same overhead view of the off-white paper with the cobalt rectangle, now with a perfect, true edge; the scalpel lies parked parallel to it; ink-blue drafting surface
directions: identical framing to the first shot
pulled back slightly, more of the dark table visible

motion.prompt: Stillness; the light breathes very slightly, then slowly dims towards ink
